release_notes: New: creating and editing a landing directly from a campaign stream is no longer a 3-field quick form — it now matches the full landing editor (and Keitaro). Four type tabs (Local / Redirect / Preload / Action), group and status, a named folder for local landings, a redirect-method selector, the full Action block (send-to-campaign / 404 / text / HTML / nothing) with no more misleading placeholder in its input, and the offer-link hint with copy button and HTML/JS/PHP formats. A new Edit button next to each landing in the stream opens the existing landing in the same modal. Localised across all seven UI languages.
